subject: Superintendent Evaluation Template and Process
overview: The Evaluation Subcommittee met to review and finalize the template, instructions, and compilation process for the 2022–2023 superintendent evaluation. The subcommittee approved the materials and forwarded them to the full School Committee for consideration.

items.title: DESE Evaluation Template Review
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the state evaluation tool populated with the superintendent's goals and highlighted focus indicators, discussing text sizing and district identification options.

items.title: Evaluation Instructions and Comment Process
items.summary: Members reviewed the draft instructional sheet for committee evaluators and agreed that the subcommittee will compile bulleted representative comments rather than drafting a synthesized narrative, setting an individual submission deadline of May 21.

items.title: Approval of Evaluation Materials and Process
items.summary: Approved a motion to adopt the evaluation template, instructions, and process, placing the package on the May 1 School Committee agenda for consideration.
